name: Love of Money Scale (LMS)
instruction: Please indicate your level of agreement with the following statements (1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree).

items.text: It would be wonderful to be wealthy.
Having a lot of financial wealth is a key dream of mine.
Money motivates me to work harder.
Financial incentives strongly inspire my daily efforts.
I am driven to achieve goals when tangible rewards are offered.
Money is an important measure of personal success.
Money gives you respect in society.
Financial stability is essential to high self-worth.
